messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 4532 — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (hosted-west1). P1 alert. Current error rate ~12% over 5m, increased latency. Paging eng-oncall.

Priya Rao: I'm on the last 10m of my shift. Quick handoff: observed backend 503s from transformer shards, appears correlated with a recent rollout to model-optimized kernel v2. Repro steps: hit /v1/generate with seq_len 2048 and saw 503s from gpu-node-17.

Priya Rao: Current owners: primary=me until 18:00 UTC. I want to transfer driving to Jamal. Comms owner? Maya? Sato please be secondary (DB/cache watch).

Jamal K: taking driver. I'll be primary from now. Can you paste the exact logs / breadcrumb?

Priya Rao: pasting quick logs.
```
[2026-03-15T17:02:12Z] gpu-node-17 tok_error: kv cache OOM -> abort generation
[2026-03-15T17:02:13Z] proxy-host-west1 503 upstream_error: model-serving-timeout
[2026-03-15T17:02:14Z] autoscaler: no extra capacity available, queue length spiked
```

Priya Rao: immediate mitigation steps I tried: rolled back kernel v2 -> v1 on node-17 (partial), did a soft scale +2 (no immediate effect). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/4532 (see section "kernel rollback + queue drain").

Jamal K: thanks. I'll continue rollback across the shard group and monitor token failure rate. Plan: rollback v2 -> v1 on all nodes in shard-group-7; if that doesn't reduce 5xx below 2% in 10m, escalate to infra and consider draining node pool.

Maya: I'll take comms. Drafting a short status for #customers and support already. Will ping CS with the impact matrix: affected endpoints /v1/generate, estimated 5% of requests affected (some retries), possible customer-facing latency increases.

Sato N: watching redis prefix cache and the DB. I'll run the quick health check and watch KV cache memory. If OOMing, we should bump cache limit and clear stale prefixes. Running: 
```bash
# check kv cache mem on node-17
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kvctl status --node gpu-node-17 --format short
```

Sato N: quick check shows kv cache at 93% on node-17, others ~40%. That matches OOMs for long seqs. Suggest temporary increase of kv_cache_limit for node-17 to 1.2x and trigger prefix-cache purge.

Jamal K: agreed. I'll coordinate cache bump and continue rollback. Priya, anything else I should know about rollout flags?

Priya Rao: there's a feature flag enabled for v2 which enables more aggressive KV prefetch. It was toggled on 16:45 UTC for west1. I didn't flip the flag off yet because partial rollback patch didn't clear service-level flag. Flag name: model_kernel_v2_prefetch=true.

Jamal K: ok I'll flip it off in the control plane (rollout-service) and propagate. Command: 
```bash
redctl feature set model_kernel_v2_prefetch false --env hosted-west1 --team infra
```

Maya: posted interim note to #customers: "We're investigating elevated errors on /v1/generate in west1. Teams are rolling back a recent kernel change; we expect reduced errors in ~15 minutes. We'll update in 10m." Added support ticket #INC-4532 and tagged the top affected customers.

Priya Rao: handing off pager. Jamal driving, Maya comms, Sato secondary. I'll stay reachable for 5 more mins in case anything blocks the rollback. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager reassigned: primary -> Jamal K, secondary -> Sato N, comms -> Maya. Escalation window extended by 30m.

Jamal K: started rolling back across shard-group-7 now. Pushing commands slowly to avoid cache thrash. Will post short status updates every 5m.

Sato N: kicked prefix purge on node-17. Monitoring mem and token errors. If kv cache OOM persists after rollback+purge, we should consider node-replace (gpu-node-17).

Maya: support updated, CS notified, scheduled a 30min check-in with affected account managers at 17:45 UTC.

Jamal K: first 5min after rollback: 5xx dropped to 6% down from 12%. Continuing. If it stabilizes <2% within 15m we close P1 and document RCA steps.

Priya Rao: great handoff. Leaving now. Good luck team.

Maya: thanks Priya. Jamal, ping when stable and I'll craft final customer note.

Jamal K: will do.

Sato N: monitoring alerts set: token_errors > 2% for 3m -> notify j.kamal@srv; kv_cache > 90% -> page infra.

Jamal K: summary checklist for whoever takes next shift:
- primary: continue watching 5xx and latency metrics (token_errors and upstream_503)
- comms: one consolidated update every 10m to #customers and support ticket
- secondary: watch kv cache memory and autoscaler queue length
- runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/4532 -> follow "rollback + cache purge" section
- elevation: if errors do not fall <2% in 15m, page infra and prepare node-replace

Maya: acknowledged. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: THREAD NOTE: last action recorded 1758210300. If no P1 criteria met in the next 30m the incident will be downgraded automatically.
